title: Pixel Taxi Neighborhoods
short: Friendly fares, little city stories, and a taxi that grows with your driver.
strap: A little city. A hundred stories to bring home.
cards: Find your way through the Foundry, Central and Garden districts, with a new friendly fare around the corner.
Choose a job, reach the pickup curb, and bring your passenger home. Unusual guests make a familiar route feel new.
Grow your driver level, improve the engine, comfort and radio, and pick a color that feels like your taxi.
